title: Login to entry_reveal: where the session token actually lives
caption: vault_unlock can fail with two_factor_required before any token exists; only vault_gate_verify mints one. The bridge strips it from the response and holds it in Rust — the webview learns only that it is authenticated, and the token reappears only bridge-side, attached to later calls like entry_reveal.

messages.label: vault.gate_verify { code } — still no token attached
AuthState { authenticated: true } — token captured, held in Rust
entry.reveal { node, entry } — token attached by dispatch_at
{ node, entry, value } — plaintext only, never the token
